svg.aria-label: MediaLog's log as a drawer of punched cards, filed five years at a time
svg.title: The log, five years at a time
svg.desc: A wooden drawer labelled EVERYTHING holds a deck of 80-column punched cards, one per log entry, each with a stripe in its kind's colour and the entry printed along the top edge. Navy guide cards with tabs read 2025-2029, 2015-2019 and SOMETIME IN 2015-2019. The cards read: 2026, 21 MAR, TV SHOW, GENTLE ROUNDABOUTS, M. FENNIMORE, S2 E1-10, loved. 2026, FEB, BOOK, QUEUEING: A HISTORY, DR P. HALLOWAY, AUDIOBOOK, liked. 2016, 12 NOV, MOVIE, THE KETTLE THAT KNEW, A. OKONJO-PELL, GLORIOUS MESS with a little face. And at the front, with no year and no date punched: GAME, TIDY THE MOON, WOBBLY SHELF, liked. A key on the drawer front gives each kind its colour: movies red, TV shows and anime blue, books amber, comics and manga magenta, games green, podcasts violet, music teal, videos plum.
